resources.title: LithiumX
resources.description: A native nxdk dashboard with title browsing, artwork support and an FTP server.
resources.setup: Extract the complete folder to an applications directory on your existing homebrew-enabled Xbox, such as E:/Apps/LithiumX/. Launch default.xbe from your current dashboard. The first launch creates E:/UDATA/LithiumX/lithiumx.toml for search paths.
resources.notes: This original repository is archived. Its v0.9.7 notes fix cache clearing affecting E:/CACHE. Keep your existing dashboard and configuration; no boot-dashboard replacement is required.

resources.title: NevolutionX
resources.description: An original Xbox dashboard and application launcher built with nxdk. The release ZIP contains a native Xbox ISO.
resources.setup: Extract NevolutionX.iso from the ZIP, then use an Xbox XISO-aware tool on your PC to extract its complete application folder. Transfer default.xbe and all companion assets together to a separate directory, for example E:/Apps/NevolutionX/, and launch from your current dashboard. The project documents DHCP networking and an automatically started FTP server with xbox/xbox credentials.
resources.notes: The nevox_hdd.zip emulator HDD image is deliberately excluded. This is the native application ISO in its original ZIP, not an emulator HDD image or a directly installable folder ZIP.

resources.title: SDLPoPX
resources.description: The original Xbox port of the SDLPoP Prince of Persia engine.
resources.setup: Extract the complete Xbox release into a separate game folder, for example E:/Games/SDLPoPX/. Keep the supplied data and configuration beside default.xbe, then launch it from your existing dashboard.
resources.notes: Use the Xbox ZIP linked here. The similarly named Xbox-Homebrew/SDLPoP release is an APPX/UWP build, which is not an original Xbox XBE.
